description.p: SourceTube is a privacy-focused YouTube client with a sharp-cornered, monospace dark interface. It proxies metadata, blocks trackers, and plays video through a bundled DASH player served from its own origin.
Version 1.1.3 adds same-origin DASH playback, SponsorBlock, local adblock, Google sign-in with a transfer wizard, and a new original icon.
Same-origin DASH playback, SponsorBlock, bundled adblock rules, Google transfer wizard, local font and new icon.
